Q1: How should the required automation-path grant for `scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh` be supplied before implementation?
Choices:
A) Before `/approved`, the pipeline account or an OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR edits this issue's body to add a `files_touched:` block. It lists `scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh`, the new or changed test file under `tests/`, and the new `changelog.d/<n>-<slug>.md` fragment by exact path. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Proceed without a `files_touched:` block. **Note:** implement will reject the staged script edit with `reason=no_allowlist` again and latch `ai:scope-blocked`, which repeats the #6772 failure.
C) Do not run the pipeline. A person implements the change by hand on a branch and closes this issue against that PR.
Q2: Which conflicted paths may the deterministic template-twin resolution handle while `CONFLICT_HOOK_TEMPLATE_RESOLVE_ENABLED=true`?
Choices:
A) Only regular files directly under `.claude/hooks/` whose `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/<same name>` twin is a regular file that merged cleanly. Skip any path listed in `.github/ai/claude_template_divergence.json`; those keep the host-only refusal. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Any `.claude/**` regular file (hooks, commands, `settings.json`) whose `workflow-templates/.claude/**` twin is a regular file that merged cleanly.
C) Only the specific hook that conflicted in #6772 (`.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py`). Every other path keeps the host-only refusal.
